verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own ingestion page stating that the s3() and url() table functions and INSERT 'work as documented', and its migration docs describe bridging data through object storage. That is a single-command path for bulk-loading from cloud object storage. However, the evidence never names CSV, JSON, or Parquet, nor any storage beyond S3, so format coverage is only implied by ClickHouse compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CSV/JSON/Parquet format support, a concrete documented bulk-load command example, coverage of GCS/Azure object storage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
